name: Argument Structure
mechanism:
This method performs linguistic analysis for AI-generated 텍스트 detection:

1. **Text Preprocessing**: The input 텍스트 is tokenized and processed for analysis.

2. **특징 추출**: Analyzes argument chain structure. Relevant linguistic features are computed from the 텍스트.

3. **Statistical Analysis**: Features are compared against baseline distributions from human-written vs AI-generated corpora.

4. **Pattern Detection**: Anomalous patterns characteristic of AI generation are identified.

5. **점수 계산**: A confidence score (0-100) is calculated based on detected patterns.
parameters:
분석 유형: 통계
미디어: 텍스트
입력: Raw 텍스트 string
Minimum 텍스트 length: 100 characters
출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)
처리 방식: Client-side NLP analysis
accuracy: 중간~높음 — 65-85% 단독 정확도. Performance increases significantly when combined with complementary 텍스트 analysis methods. Results vary with 텍스트 length, language, and content type.
source: Statistical NLP analysis methods for AI-generated 텍스트 detection. Based on computational linguistics and information theory research.
useCase: Detection of AI-generated 텍스트 through argument structure analysis. This method examines specific linguistic patterns that differ between human-written and AI-generated 텍스트, providing complementary evidence in a multi-method analysis pipeline.
strengths:
• Fast client-side analysis with no server required
• Effective as part of a multi-method analysis pipeline
• Works across various 텍스트 types and genres
• Based on established linguistic research
• Complements other 통계 텍스트 analysis methods
limitations:
• Best used in combination with other 텍스트 analysis methods
• Performance varies with 텍스트 length (requires sufficient 텍스트)
• May be affected by 텍스트 language and writing style
• Accuracy depends on the AI model used for generation
• Human writing can occasionally trigger false positives

references.title: Jurafsky, D. & Martin, J.H. (2024). Speech and Language Processing. 3rd Edition.
Guo, B. et al. (2023). How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? Comparison Corpus, Evaluation, and Detection. NeurIPS.
